summary.content:
Today's selection covers 83 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 55 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: EU orders Meta to open WhatsApp to rival AI chatbots
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: WhatsApp says it disrupted new NSO spyware phishing attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 72 articles published in the last 24 hours
